title: Integral conjugacy normal form for trace-squared-four matrices
statement: For every γ∈SL₂(ℤ) whose matrix trace satisfies tr(γ)^2=4, there exist σ∈SL₂(ℤ) and m∈ℤ such that σ⁻¹γσ=T^m or σ⁻¹γσ=−T^m, where T=(1 1;0 1). This includes γ=I and γ=−I.
lean_statement: ∀ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ).trace ^ 2 = 4 → ∃ (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (m : ℤ), σ⁻¹ * γ * σ = ModularGroup.T ^ m ∨ σ⁻¹ * γ * σ = -(ModularGroup.T ^ m)
